Implemented the source-only compatibility fix for `@babel/parser` 7.13.11.

Updated Prettier to preserve `import type` on TypeScript `TSImportEqualsDeclaration` nodes and to accept Babel’s new recoverable parser error for invalid type-only import aliases. No test files or dependency manifests were modified.
